doc.title: David Weiss interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 3, 2022

title: Joking about a benefactor and a visit to Hamilton
summary: Rowe and Weiss joke about finding a patron, and Weiss says the Cookers would love to visit the college and meet students.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: I hope that you get to that and that it comes to fruition.
Well it looks like I’ve got a year of a benefactor. You’re going to hook that up, right?
I’m going to work on it.
We’re talking Ivy League now?
I started it, didn’t I?
No, we’ve had help from friends. During the pandemic people helped us get the record done. I have to say that.
Excellent.
Yeah I mean in a way we’re going back to that, you know, oh what’s the word for it — benefactor is not the word. What was the — what did Mozart have?
He had a patron.
Patron. That’s what I’m looking — in a way we’re going back to that, right? I mean you know —
Yes, we need to.
We may, whatever, you know.
Well I’m going to go buy a few lottery tickets on the way home and you know.
How many million do you have to win before you’d think about us?
About seven.
Okay. Fair enough. It can’t be the first million, I understand.
That’s okay.
We’re not unreasonable.
Okay. Well I am hoping you can come up here and cook. And this has been a fascinating conversation and I appreciate your time.
Have you been talking to the other guys yet?
Not yet but I will.
They’ve got stuff too.
I bet they have some stuff.
It’d be great to come up there, if we can figure that out.
Great.
And it’s a school, right? The students. It would be great for those guys to get together with the students.
Indeed.
